articles.summary: The Swedish Transport Workers’ Union (Transport) and Ryanair have signed a collective agreement. The agreement covers Ryanair’s Arlanda base in Sweden and means that the cabin crew will now receive collectively agreed wages and terms of employment. The signing of the agreement is also an important success for the Swedish labour market model. Following negotiations between Transport and the airline, a collective agreement is now in place for Ryanair’s cabin crew at Arlanda in Sweden. […]
